concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-netsuite-payment-notifications-in-netsuite]] — 2023-modified NetSuite asynchronous payment/chargeback notification log guide captured 2026-09-15, including revocable `approved` status and multiple notification entries; log receipt is not financial finality.
warnings: An approved=true authorization status may later be revoked; do not equate a notification or sales-order status with final payment success, capture or settlement.
Immediate display is measured after NetSuite receives a notification, not from provider event creation or across network delivery.
Multiple Payment Processing Profiles may yield multiple log entries for one transaction; chargeback records do not prove final dispute or bank outcome.
